variables.title: Before/after deployment analysis
variables.query: FROM lab-${run_id} | STATS requests = COUNT(*), failures = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure", p95 = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95) BY service.version | SORT p95 DESC

demonstration.narration: I'll group by service.version and calculate request counts, failures, and p95 latency to see whether the release changed both errors and speed.
demonstration.reasoning: Each pipeline stage has a distinct job. Filtering before STATS keeps unrelated rows out of the measures; grouping and sorting let us compare the resulting values.
demonstration.evidence: The result table now contains one row per ${var.field} group and the calculated values. Compare the rows to identify which group stands out.

demonstration.narration: I'll compare each version's failures against its request count, then check p95 latency, to see whether the release worsened both.
demonstration.reasoning:
A top-ranked name without its numbers is not enough evidence, and numbers without the group key have no owner.

Reading both parts verifies that the query result supports the intended comparison rather than merely returning rows.
demonstration.evidence:
The decisive row should pair ${truth.finding} with ${truth.scope}.

Those concrete values corroborate the aggregation and justify the conclusion: ${truth.conclusion}
